headline.en: Check an edit claim against the code that changed.
headline.zh: 用实际代码变化检查编辑声明。

sub.en: DiffGate parses before and after source blobs, computes structural changes and compares them with explicit edit claims.
sub.zh: DiffGate 解析修改前后源码，计算结构变化，并与明确编辑声明进行比较。

body.en: The verdict comes from source structure.
Claims can target a specific symbol scope.
body.zh: 声明可以针对具体符号作用域。

body.en: CLI and MCP expose the same verifier.
body.zh: CLI 与 MCP 暴露同一验证器。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: Compare the same explicit foo-to-bar rename claim against unchanged Python source and a real renamed function.
note.zh: 将相同 foo 到 bar 改名声明分别与未变源码和实际改名函数比较。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: Verify an explicit Python rename claim against unchanged and actually renamed source blobs using the production tree-sitter verifier.
steps.output:
{"case": "unchanged", "passed": false, "mismatches": ["claimed rename foo\u2192bar but neither name appears in the structural diff (no-op edit)"]}
{"case": "renamed", "passed": true, "mismatches": []}

body.en: Compare the same explicit foo-to-bar rename claim against unchanged Python source and a real renamed function.
body.zh: 将相同 foo 到 bar 改名声明分别与未变源码和实际改名函数比较。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/diffgate.git
cd diffgate
uv venv .venv
uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e .
source .venv/bin/activate

limitations.en: A structural match does not prove semantic correctness, complete reference updates or passing tests.
limitations.zh: 结构匹配不证明语义正确、所有引用已更新或测试通过。

limitations.en: Claims cover the supported action vocabulary and parser behavior. Keep normal testing alongside this gate.
limitations.zh: 声明受支持动作词汇与解析器行为限制，应继续配合常规测试。

limitations.en: The demo checks only a small Python rename case, not every supported language or cross-file scenario.
limitations.zh: 示例只检查小型 Python 改名案例，不覆盖所有语言或跨文件场景。

body.en: A successful tool response can still leave the source unchanged or modify the wrong symbol. An explicit before/after claim lets a harness check that structural work occurred before continuing.
body.zh: 工具返回成功时，源码仍可能未变，或改到了错误符号。明确的前后声明让调用框架在继续运行前检查结构工作是否发生。

body.en: Tree-sitter parsers extract symbols and scopes. The verifier computes added, deleted, signature-changed and body-changed symbols, then matches supported claimed actions. CLI and MCP return the same deterministic verdict and mismatch evidence.
body.zh: Tree-sitter 解析器提取符号和作用域。验证器计算新增、删除、签名变化与函数体变化，再匹配支持的动作声明。CLI 与 MCP 返回相同的确定性结论和不匹配证据。

body.en: Tree-sitter parsers extract symbols and scopes. The verifier computes added, deleted, signature-changed and body-changed symbols, then matches supported claimed actions. CLI and MCP return the same deterministic verdict and mismatch evidence.
body.zh: Tree-sitter 解析器提取符号和作用域。验证器计算新增、删除、签名变化与函数体变化，再匹配支持的动作声明。CLI 与 MCP 返回相同的确定性结论和不匹配证据。

body.en: The following routes are implemented in the source. Choose the input that matches your task and keep the resulting artifact with your project.
body.zh: 以下路径已有源码实现。按任务选择输入，并把生成的结果与项目一起保存。

body.en: Select before/after files and a supported claim. --lang can override extension-based detection; --json emits structured data. Programmatic EditClaim accepts source blobs, language and ClaimedAction objects with optional scope and new_symbol.
body.zh: 指定前后文件与支持的声明。--lang 可覆盖按扩展名检测的语言，--json 输出结构化数据。程序接口 EditClaim 接受源码、语言以及带可选 scope、new_symbol 的 ClaimedAction。

body.en: The CLI exposes the following operations. Commands after the example use your own paths or identifiers.
body.zh: CLI 提供以下操作。示例之外的命令需要替换成你的文件路径或标识。

details.code:
diffgate verify --before before.py --after after.py --claim "rename foo->bar" --json
diffgate diff --before before.py --after after.py --json
diffgate mcp-server --stdio
